name: High error percentage per service
warnings: 'percentage_match': the match_bucket_filter was translated to an ES|QL CASE() expression — verify the generated EVAL clause matches your original intent.
esql_query:
FROM logs-app-* METADATA _id, _version, _index
| EVAL is_match = CASE(http.response.status_code == 500, 1, 0)
| STATS matched = SUM(is_match), total = COUNT(*) BY service.name
| EVAL match_pct = 100.0 * matched / total
| WHERE match_pct > 30
| KEEP service.name, match_pct
source_yaml:
name: High error percentage per service
type: percentage_match
index: logs-app-*
match_bucket_filter:
- term:
    http.response.status_code: 500
max_percentage: 30
query_key: service.name
timeframe:
  minutes: 15

name: Spike in authentication failures
warnings: 'spike' converted approximately: the current-window vs reference-window comparison (spike_height=3) cannot be reproduced exactly in ES|QL. A ready-to-run Elasticsearch ML anomaly-detection job (faithful to spike_height/threshold_cur) is included in this rule's note field as an optional, more accurate alternative.
esql_query:
FROM logs-* METADATA _id, _version, _index
| WHERE (event.outcome == "failure")
| EVAL bucket = DATE_TRUNC(1 hour, @timestamp)
| STATS event_count = COUNT(*) BY bucket, source.ip
| WHERE event_count >= 50
| KEEP bucket, source.ip, event_count
source_yaml:
name: Spike in authentication failures
type: spike
index: logs-*
spike_height: 3
spike_type: up
threshold_cur: 50
query_key: source.ip
timeframe:
  hours: 1
filter:
- query:
    query_string:
      query: event.outcome:failure
